stem.en: A pollen grain lands on the stigma of a china-rose flower and grows a tube, but the tube is blocked part-way down the style. Which statement is correct?

text.en: Pollinated and fertilised, as pollen landed

feedback.en: Landing is pollination only. Fertilisation needs the gametes to fuse.
Yes. Pollen reached the stigma, but the male gamete never reached the egg cell.

text.en: Fertilised but not yet pollinated at all

feedback.en: Pollination comes first. Here fertilisation has not happened.

text.en: Neither pollinated nor fertilised at all

feedback.en: Pollen reached the stigma, so pollination did happen.

explanation.en: Pollen reaching the stigma is pollination, so that part is complete. Fertilisation is the fusion of the male gamete with the egg cell. A blocked tube stops the gamete, so no zygote forms.

hints.en: Two events are described. Which one has already happened?
Does the male gamete reach the egg cell?
